result_text:
I changed `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` so it only returns stock rows with a quantity above zero. The WHERE clause is now `s.warehouse_id = ? AND s.quantity > 0`, the same condition the other stock overviews use.

I ran the offline Maven tests for `StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `StockAdjustmentTest` and `StockPerCategoryTest`. Quiet mode printed no errors, so they passed, though I did not capture the exit code. I did not add a test for the warehouse list case in your example. Nothing is committed.
